Vue provides built-in mechanisms like v-memo, asynchronous components, and Suspense to help developers optimize bundle sizes, defer costly computations, and handle asynchronous rendering gracefully."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Memoizing Templates with v-memo"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"The v-memo directive allows you to memoize a sub-tree of the template. It takes an array of dependency values to watch. If all values in the array are the same as the previous render, the entire sub-tree update is skipped entirely, even during virtual DOM diffing."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"

Lazy Loading with Async Components"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"To reduce the initial bundle size, large components can be split into separate chunks and loaded lazily using Vue's defineAsyncComponent helper. This tells the bundler to create a separate asynchronous chunk that downloads only when the component is rendered."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"import { defineAsyncComponent } from 'vue'; const HeavyChartComponent = defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./components/HeavyChart.vue') );"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can also configure advanced loading options, such as custom loading states, error states, and timeouts, to manage network latency gracefully."},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Handling Async States with Suspense"},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"Vue's Suspense is a built-in component that coordinates dependency resolution for asynchronous child components or components utilizing async setup functions. It allows you to display a fallback template while the underlying async dependencies are resolved."},{"order":13,"type":"code","text":""},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"v-memo: Skips virtual DOM diffing for static or conditionally updated template sub-trees."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Async Components: Splits heavy components into separate bundles to optimize initial page load times."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Suspense: Coordinates loading states seamlessly for components relying on asynchronous operations."}]
